args.title: Corvid Packaging newsletter: Retail returns logistics (three-bullet summary)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Corvid Packaging, "Retail returns logistics"): this week's issue is on retail returns logistics, pointing to the Corvid blog article and a company-tailored companion version.
- Article (blog.corvid.example/2026/returns): apparel return rates have reached 24%, while consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/returns/companion, tailored for Northwind Analytics): resale within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
